sections.text: Below the lighthouse, a shutter blinks three times from a boat on the reef. The tide has uncovered two routes across the rocks.

options.description: Cross the reef before the waves return

consequence.text: A wave knocks you against the reef.

sections.text: At the last post you find a rope stretched to the boat. Someone on deck pulls it taut.

options.description: Catch your breath and finish the job

consequence.text: A moment of rest restores your strength.

sections.text: You can still turn back. The safer route is within reach.

options.description: Go back and take the safer route

consequence.text: You are hit again before you can get to safety.

sections.text: You lead the stranded crew back to the lighthouse before the tide comes in.
